note: P repeats one mechanism in all four: a lifted face with a blurred glow tail fading out, the same cubic-bezier pair, and the same 'Tune the motion' panel, with only the page context and surface swapped. Q varies more in what moves (colour shift with scale in Q1, background-position sheen in Q2, skewed sweep with motes in Q3, diagonal sheen on a dark button in Q4) and in palette, though Q2 and Q4 share the sheen idea and Q1 and Q3 share the violet primary.
